credits_text: XELOT FILMS PRESENTS A BORLAND RIVER MEDIA PRODUCTION "THE HUNTER" PRODUCED BY RACHELLE HARDY AND JACOB SMILLEY DIRECTOR OF PHOTOGRAPHY LENNI UTTO WRITTEN AND DIRECTED BY MICHAEL MERRELL
description: A woman stands with her back to the viewer in a dark, dense forest, facing an unseen threat. The poster has a moody, suspenseful atmosphere.
